This points me toward a different handoff pattern: rather than passing the Agent object itself as a tool, Genkit's common "agent handoff" approach wraps a call to the sub-agent's chat session inside `ai.defineTool`, where the parent's tool accepts a simple string input and internally invokes the sub-agent's `.chat().send()`, returning the text while the parent retains control of the session. This matches the test's requirement that a session can be resumed later by its session id, letting the customer continue the same conversation thread.
